title: docs: rewrite roadmaps — consolidate v3.0, stage v4.0 enterprise plan
body:
Full codebase audit against spec protocol conventions, followed by roadmap restructuring to reflect actual state and organize next development phases.

### Audit findings (v3.0.2)

| Metric | Previously documented | Actual |
|--------|----------------------|--------|
| Zod schemas | 171 | **175** |
| Test files / tests | 191 / 5,157 | **195 / 5,269** |
| `.describe()` annotations | 7,095 | **7,111** |
| Service contracts | 24 | **25** |
| v4.0 planned files implemented | — | **0/19** |

All 15 protocol domains have 100% schema↔test coverage. v3.0 is fully shipped.

### ROADMAP.md

- **Collapsed v3.0 Phases 5–11** (~500 lines of completed task tables) into a summary + `<details>` block
- **Added Protocol Domain Coverage table** with per-domain schema/test counts
- **Restructured v4.0** from flat Phase 12–17 list into 3 staged milestones:
  - **Stage 1 (alpha):** Data Model + UI/Reporting — 6 weeks
  - **Stage 2 (beta):** Automation + System/DevOps — 4 weeks
  - **Stage 3 (GA):** AI/Intelligence + Service Contracts — 3 weeks
- Updated all stale metrics to match audit

### DX_ROADMAP.md

- **Collapsed completed Phases 1–3** into `<details>` blocks
- Confirmed Phase 4 (CLI & Tooling) as active (2/10 done)
- Aligned metrics and cross-references with ROADMAP.md
